summary: Retest of the iteration_116 fixes for Phase C (mobile MART + FOOD) on the web preview (390x844) plus backend pytest. All 6 fixes are verified and the regression happy path passes. Backend: 20/20 pass. FIX 1: logged in, cart-subtotal and cart-total matched GET /mart/cart/eligibility after every +/- press (10 checks with MART only, including rapid presses), and also with a FOOD line in the cart (9 checks, including a FOOD qty change). FIX 2: /cart/quote prices Banane x2 at 1800; it matches eligibility (x3 = 2700); the guest cart total of 6000 (1800 + 3700 + 500) stays the same after login. FIX 3: the FOOD order shows 'Passée' in order-status and in the Activity badge. FIX 4: in pickup mode the warning reads 'Ce restaurant ne propose pas la vente à emporter…' and cart-checkout has aria-disabled=true and opacity 0.5; in delivery mode there is no warning and opacity is 1. FIX 5: pickup at burger_hub_ci returns 409 'Ce restaurant ne propose pas la vente à emporter.'; delivery with delivery_enabled=false (pizza_palace_ci switched off for the test, then restored) returns 409 'Ce restaurant ne propose pas la livraison.'; delivery orders still return 201. FIX 6: slot chips read 'Dès que possible', '09:34 – 10:04', 'mar. 20 09:00 – 11:00' and so on. Regression: guest adds MART (Banane x2) and FOOD (Crispy Wings + Sauce extra, 3700) -> cart -> checkout -> login -> OTP -> back to /checkout -> COD -> both orders placed -> MART tracking screen (Confirmée, timeline, driver) -> FOOD order cancelled (server says cancelled) -> reorder goes to the cart with the line (3700).

ui_bugs.issue: Still open from iter116: reordered FOOD lines have no image (blank thumbnail in the cart).
Opening an order deep link without a session shows 'Connexion impossible. Vérifiez votre réseau' instead of asking the user to log in.

action_items: (LOW) Store the item image on reordered FOOD lines
(LOW) When an order deep link returns 401, show a login prompt instead of the network error
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.setMartQty: when a product is added while logged in, the line has no server id until reload() finishes. A second tap in that window sends another POST instead of a PATCH. In testing the quantities stayed correct (rapid presses on an existing line were fine), but it is worth guarding by disabling the stepper while a mutation is in flight.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested fixes and the regression flow

seed_data_creation: No seed data was changed. pizza_palace_ci.delivery_enabled was set to false only for the 409 check and then restored to true. Test orders and carts were created for +225 0700000001 and random 07xxxxxxxx numbers.
